page_title: WHU 3-2 FUL | West Ham v Fulham 14/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Adama Traore (Fulham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90+2' Adama Traore (Fulham) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Joshua King (Fulham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
89' It seemed like Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
85' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Alex Iwobi will be replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harry Wilson departs the field of play to be replaced by Joshua King (Fulham).
83' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) tries to find Lucas Paqueta, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
81' Graham Potter has decided to make a change. Oliver Scarles (West Ham) replaces Guido Rodriguez.
81' Emerson comes off the pitch to be replaced by Aaron Cresswell (West Ham).

80' What a wasted opportunity by Raul Jimenez (Fulham)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Lukasz Fabianski makes an astonishing save to thwart him.

78' 3 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Alex Iwobi (Fulham) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
77' The game is interrupted as Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is flagged offside.
76' 43:57 – the ratio of ball possession.
72' Here's the change. Carlos Soler leaves the pitch and Andrew Irving (West Ham) comes on as a substitute.
72' Harry Wilson (Fulham) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Lukasz Fabianski.
70' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
68' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Andreas Pereira is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
68' The referee signals a substitution. Adama Traore (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Emile Smith Rowe.
67' 3 - 1 GOAL! Keeper Bernd Leno totally miss kicks the ball straight to Lucas Paqueta (West Ham), who slams the ball into the net from mid range. It’s now 3:1.
66' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
65' What was Sasa Lukic (Fulham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
63' Substitution. Mohammed Kudus makes his way off the pitch and Danny Ings (West Ham) comes on as his replacement.
61' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
60' Fulham are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
59' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes a short corner kick.
58' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner with a short pass.
56' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
56' The Fulham players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
53' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
51' Goal! Alex Iwobi (Fulham) finds some space for a shot from the edge of the box and his attempt goes low inside the right post. Fantastic finish.
49' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
48' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
47' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Craig Pawson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
42' A perfect long pass by Joachim Andersen (Fulham) finds Raul Jimenez. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
40' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lukasz Fabianski comes off the line to clear the ball away.
39' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
37' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
37' The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.

33' 2 - 0 Goal! Aaron Wan-Bissaka plays in Tomas Soucek (West Ham), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the top of the net! Great finish - 2:0.
31' 1 - 0 GOAL! Carlos Soler (West Ham) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
31' The foul by Edson Alvarez (West Ham) was seen by Craig Pawson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
29' Here comes the VAR decision. NO GOAL, the ref disallows it due to offside.
29' The goal for West Ham is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
27' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Max Kilman (West Ham) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
27' West Ham are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
25' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
25' The ball is cleared after Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
20' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
18' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
17' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
12' Harry Wilson (Fulham) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
11' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) passes the ball onto Mohammed Kudus, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
8' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
6' Harry Wilson (Fulham) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
3' Fulham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Fulham will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Craig Pawson.
